task_world.public_context: The UI helps with fall_schedule_case_216 by reviewing remaining degree requirements, available sections, fixed work commitments, prerequisite and schedule validation, enrollment cart staging, submission, and refreshed enrollment status.

difficulty_profile.schema_fidelity: Read tools return case-specific state, evidence, candidates, or status objects; write tools return success/error wrappers plus operation, saved-state, submission, hold, confirmation, or audit/readback objects.
difficulty_profile.tool_selection_noise: The task includes non-authoritative helper tools (course_get_advisor_hint) that must stay separate from current proof, along with invalid, blocked, stale, or lower-confidence records in authoritative outputs.
difficulty_profile.state_pressure: Turns combine safe initial review, non-mutating comparison or validation, staged or scoped action, fresh readback after mutation, preservation of rejected alternatives, cross-turn continuity, and final evidence-chain reconstruction.

mechanism_mix.label: conflicting source arbitration
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: The UI must keep authoritative case state separate from secondary, stale, advisory, or conflicting evidence.

mechanism_mix.label: fresh-state gate after mutation
mechanism_mix.eval_focus: After any write-like action, the UI must refresh authoritative status before presenting completion.

validation_scenarios.name: course schedule turn 1
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Build the fall_schedule_case_216 planner before creating or submitting a cart.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must show remaining requirements, sections, work commitments, and an empty cart/submission state while supporting interactive section selection.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge by tool calls, visible evidence, backend state, and assistant/UI alignment; do not require exact visual layout.

evidence_requirements.expect: UI reads degree audit, sections, work schedule, and current no-enrollment-status state for fall_schedule_case_216
course sections can be selected and compared by requirement, time, seat status, and prerequisite
assistant text does not claim a cart was submitted before successful submit and readback

validation_scenarios.name: course schedule turn 2
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Add prerequisite, requirement, schedule, seat, and work-conflict validation.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must validate prerequisites first, then validate degree coverage, open seats, section conflicts, and work conflicts, while separating an older advisor hint from current validation.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Do not penalize different recommendation wording if the valid/invalid section combinations and stale hint boundary are correct.

evidence_requirements.expect: UI checks prerequisites for selected sections before schedule validation
UI flags the CS341-A and STAT310-A time conflict, the CS341-B work/waitlist issue, and missing requirement coverage when applicable
older advisor note is visible as a hint but not treated as current validation

validation_scenarios.name: course schedule turn 3
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Create a reviewable enrollment cart for a valid selected schedule without submitting it.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must stage only a prerequisite-passed and schedule-valid cart, preserving degree coverage and conflict details.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge the state boundary and validation chain; exact cart layout is flexible.

evidence_requirements.expect: cart creation uses current prerequisite and schedule validation for the selected sections

evidence_requirements.surface: runtime tool logs / backend state / DOM
evidence_requirements.expect: enrollment cart exists but enrollment status remains empty until submission
degree requirements, selected sections, work commitments, and validation results remain visible

validation_scenarios.name: course schedule turn 4
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: Submit the staged enrollment cart only if the validation still matches, then refresh enrollment status.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must submit only after current prerequisite, schedule, and cart evidence match, then show refreshed enrolled status.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: A correct UI may expose either one submit button or a review-and-submit flow, but it must not bypass validation and readback.

evidence_requirements.expect: submit uses prerequisite, schedule validation, and cart evidence for the current case
UI refreshes enrollment status after submit and shows enrolled sections
assistant text only claims enrollment after successful operation and refreshed status

validation_scenarios.name: course schedule turn 5
validation_scenarios.oracle: The final UI must reconstruct requirement coverage, selected sections, rejected alternatives, validation results, submitted status, and follow-up without inventing enrollment outcomes.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Judge by evidence-backed summary and state consistency rather than exact copy.

evidence_requirements.expect: final packet includes requirements covered, selected sections, conflict rejects, cart id if present, refreshed enrollment status, and remaining follow-up
final claims are grounded in actual validation, cart creation, submission, and enrollment readback
assistant text does not claim waitlisted or conflicting sections were enrolled unless backend status supports it

turns.prompt: I need help planning fall_schedule_case_216 before registration opens. Build a schedule planner that shows my remaining degree requirements, available sections, fixed work commitments, and an empty enrollment status. I want to cover systems core, one stats elective, and one writing-intensive class, but do not create or submit a cart yet.

Add validation so the planner checks prerequisites, open seats, requirement coverage, class-time conflicts, and my work schedule. Also show the older advisor note separately from current validation, because I do not want to trust it if the section status changed.

Stage an enrollment cart for a valid combination that covers all three requirements and avoids work conflicts. Keep rejected alternatives visible so I can see why they were not chosen, but do not submit the cart yet.
Submit the staged cart only if the current prerequisite and schedule checks still match those selected sections. After submitting, refresh enrollment status so the UI shows what actually happened.
Create a final schedule packet with covered requirements, enrolled sections, rejected alternatives, validation notes, cart/submission status, and any follow-up I should handle before classes start.
